generation_costs.basis.note: Each technology with a 2024 price is costed at that price, which reproduces what was paid. Technologies without one (tidal, wave, geothermal, hydrogen turbines and storage) use the build-up. Thermal plant stays on 2024 prices, because the build-up at new-build turbine costs and 2024 fuel and carbon prices is above what the 2024 fleet was paid (see the gas check in validation).

retail.electricity.wholesale_adjustment_.note: Domestic wholesale cost above the demand weighted spot price grossed up for losses: the 2024 caps passed through power bought forward in 2023, and the domestic profile is peakier than average demand. Specific to the year, 0 in scenarios.

retail.gas.wholesale_adjustment_p_kWh.note: Ofgem cap domestic wholesale gas cost above the gas price paid by power producers (QEP 3.2.1): forward purchasing, the domestic demand profile and shrinkage. Specific to the year, 0 in scenarios.
